content.project_page_words_range: 161-178 raw HTML (~211 rendered); yesterday's 225-241 reflected shared chrome text that has since been trimmed
content.shared_chrome_change: Every page lost roughly 60-120 words of shared component text and 5 unique internal links versus 05 Aug (core 22 -> 17, articles 25-29 -> 20-24, projects 22 -> 17). /articles is the only page moving the other way (+528 words, +32 links) because it was deliberately rebuilt.

notes: The biggest fix day of the audit series: two long-standing defects were cleared at once and Health rose 83 -> 88, the highest recorded. (1) The /articles listing now server-renders all 53 article links as real anchors instead of 16, so the 37 articles that existed only in the sitemap finally have internal links; the page's unique internal-link count went 38 -> 70, its raw-HTML word count 620 -> 1148, it gained 21 JSON-LD blocks after six days at zero, and its TTFB fell 2.16s -> 1.38s so it is no longer the slowest page. That alone took Crawlability 88 -> 96. (2) The six /projects/* pages went from 0 JSON-LD (unfixed since 31 Jul) to an @graph carrying Organization + WebSite + WebPage + CreativeWork + BreadcrumbList, lifting site-wide schema coverage 88.2% -> 97.4%; only /login and /start-interactive now lack schema. Performance rose 87 -> 92 as the under-1s share went 78.9% -> 90.8% and the slowest page fell 2.16s -> 1.53s. Unfixed: the JSON-LD duplication defect enters day four, and crucially the schema added today to the project pages and /articles arrived already duplicated (14 identical blocks, 21 identical blocks) - the clearest evidence yet that a shared component or layout is responsible. Also unfixed on day seven: 7/11 homepage images and 15/19 project-page images without alt, zero lazy-loading on both, even though the team edited these very pages today to add schema. Newly detected and needing confirmation: a shared component (likely footer or nav) lost about 5 internal links and 60-120 words on every page.
